audience.text: Developers building .NET 8+ applications that require PDF creation, manipulation, conversion, and form handling without licensing fees.

capabilities.text: Create new PDF documents or open existing ones, add/delete/reorder pages, and save changes with full round-trip support for bookmarks, outlines, and metadata.
capabilities.title: Create and edit PDF documents

capabilities.text: Extract text using TextAbsorber and TextFragmentAbsorber, find and replace text across pages, and build new text content with TextFragment and TextStamp.
capabilities.title: Text extraction and manipulation

capabilities.text: Read, fill, and build AcroForm fields including text, checkbox, radio, choice, and signature fields through Form and Field APIs.
capabilities.title: Form handling

capabilities.text: Add and edit standard annotation types including link, text, free-text, highlight, stamp, and watermark annotations with appearance generation.
capabilities.title: Annotations and stamps

capabilities.text: Encrypt documents with RC4-40, RC4-128, AES-128, and AES-256, and sign with PKCS#7/CMS detached signatures including DocMDP certifying signatures.
capabilities.title: Security features

capabilities.text: Convert PDF to/from HTML, SVG, Markdown, and plain text, and render pages to PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, and SVG using pluggable device classes.
capabilities.title: Format conversion and rendering

capabilities.text: Read and build tagged content using LogicalStructure elements for accessibility compliance with PDF/UA.
capabilities.title: Tagged PDF and accessibility

capabilities.text: Extract tabular data using TableAbsorber and draw or place images using ImagePlacementAbsorber and XImageCollection.
capabilities.title: Table and image handling

limitations.text: System.Drawing.Common members like ImageDevice.GetBitmap and StampInfo.Image are Windows-only on .NET 8 and throw PlatformNotSupportedException on Linux/macOS.
AI/LowCode workflows (Aspose.Pdf.AI.*, Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.*) are out of scope; use Aspose.PDF for .NET Enterprise Edition for OCR and AI features.
Multithreading APIs (Aspose.Pdf.Multithreading.*) are not included; this edition is single-threaded for a single Document instance.
TiffDevice.BinarizeBradley and DocumentCollection.GetEnumerator() are not implemented and throw NotImplementedException.
Advanced digital signature validation options (ValidationOptions, ValidationResult, OCSP, network timestamping) are stored but not active.
PDF/A conversion fix-ups for transparency flattening, embedded-file constraints, and ICC profile downgrade are stored but not applied.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF document generation, editing, and conversion using a familiar API surface compatible with Aspose.PDF for .NET.
Supports extraction and replacement of text content, including multi-page and cross-operator spans.
Provides tools for PDF security (encryption, signing), form handling, and annotation management.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source PDF library for .NET 8+ that reads, creates, modifies, and converts PDF documents.

uncertainties: The exact scope of XFA authoring capabilities beyond basic read/flatten is unclear from available facts.
Whether all public symbols listed in the public_symbol facts are fully implemented in the FOSS edition is not explicitly confirmed.
The behavior of advanced PdfFileEditor features like MakeNUp and MakeBooklet in the save path is not fully specified.
The extent of PDF/UA-2 layout-aware tagging support beyond basic structure tree handling is not detailed.

workflows.name: Create and save PDF
workflows.text: Create a new PDF document, add pages with text content, and save to disk using Document.Create() and Document.Save().

workflows.name: Extract text
workflows.text: Open an existing PDF and extract text using TextAbsorber or TextFragmentAbsorber.

workflows.name: Add annotations
workflows.text: Add link annotations, stamp annotations, and other standard annotation types to PDF pages.

workflows.name: Convert formats
workflows.text: Convert HTML, SVG, Markdown, and plain text files to PDF, and render PDF pages to PNG, JPEG, or SVG.

workflows.name: Encrypt and sign
workflows.text: Apply encryption with AES-256 and sign documents using PKCS#7 signatures.

workflows.name: Process forms
workflows.text: Read and inspect form field values from existing PDF documents.
